# Odoo Contact Validator via LinkedIn

## Purpose
Automatically verify if contacts in Odoo still work at their listed companies using LinkedIn data via Proxycurl API.

## Features
✅ Fetches contacts from Odoo API
✅ Verifies employment via LinkedIn profiles
✅ Detects job title changes
✅ Discovers LinkedIn URLs for contacts without them
✅ Updates Odoo with verification results
✅ Generates summary reports
✅ Respects API rate limits (5s delay)

## Requirements

### 1. Proxycurl API Account
- Sign up at: https://nubela.co/proxycurl/
- Get API key
- Cost: ~$0.10-0.30 per request
- Create HTTP Header Auth credential:
  - Header Name: Authorization
  - Header Value: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY

### 2. Odoo Configuration
- Custom fields on res.partner:
  - x_linkedin_url (Char)
  - x_last_verified (Datetime)
  - x_verification_status (Selection)
  - x_verification_notes (Text)
- API access enabled
- HTTP Basic Auth or API Key

### 3. Environment Variables
- ODOO_URL: Your Odoo instance URL

## Rate Limiting
- 5 second delay between API calls
- Processes max 50 contacts per run
- Weekly schedule (adjustable)
- Skips recently verified (< 30 days)

## Cost Estimation
- 50 contacts × $0.10 = $5/week
- 200 contacts/month = ~$20/month

## Verification Flow

1. Contact HAS LinkedIn URL
   → Fetch profile directly
   → Check current employment
   → Compare with Odoo company

2. Contact has NO LinkedIn URL
   → Search by name at company
   → Find best match
   → Discover LinkedIn URL

Results:
- ✅ Verified: Still works there
- ⚠️ Left Company: Different employer
- ❓ Unable to Verify: No data
